notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27227492/3da972b8d0eacd5f6e33be4c51073d1d195b638a.png[/img]
[b]Update 1.8 is now available![/b]

[h1]Major Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Night Vision battery life / amount saving issue has been fixed!
[i]After death the battery life and quantity will reset to the last checkpoint saved data.[/i]
[*]Enemy health and damage has been reduced.
[*]Player walk / run / turn speed has been increased.
[*]PickUp Objects are now more in sight.
[*]Added more hints and text message indications.
[*]Removed objects that are blocking the Players path. 
[/list]

[h1]Minor Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bug fixes.
[/list]

[i]This update is not completely necessary, but still highly recommended to ensure better gameplay experience![/i]

[b]Caution![/b]
[i]It is strongly recommended to restart the game after update. Some changes [b]might[/b] break the game.[/i]

Apologize for the inconvenience

notes.title: Update 1.5 - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.5 is going to be released this or next week![/h1]

Update 1.5 will contain:
[olist]
[*]Ability to push object aside while running. (Reduce the chance on getting stuck in objects, [for e.g. while running from enemies]).
[*]Redesigning the night vision camera GUI.
[*]Improving the apartment level lightning.
[*]Reducing overall blurriness in game.
[*]Fixing collider problem in some of the models.
[*]Making the camera movement more smooth.
[/olist]
These are one of the biggest improvements in this upcoming update so far! If you think there's should be something else improved as well, please do not hesitate to comment down below!

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Major Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added hints to help progress the game.
[*]Can now kill some of the enemies that you couldn't before.
[*]Removed some difficult puzzles.
[*]Shorten the game by removing some unnecessary scenes.
[/list]

[i]Heard claims from people that this game is too difficult and confusing. So I decided to add some hints and other details to make the game less frustrating and more fun to play.[/i]

[b]I strongly recommend to update the game to this version (1.3) as I fixed some of important issues and added some features that will hopefully make the game more enjoyable. Especially if you're having the very first, old version of the game![/b]

notes.content:
[h1]Fixed some of the important issues in the game.[/h1]

[i]This should be the very last update on fixing issues in game. But if you will ever encounter an important issue in game don't hesitate to email me at:[/i] [b]BlackClothGames@Gmail.com[/b]

[i]Thank you very much![/i]
